title: Claude Code plugin manifest
description: Contract for src/claude/.claude-plugin/plugin.json, the framework's identity as the harness reads it. Source, retrieved 2026-07-31 and cited in full in docs/adr/0012-distribute-the-framework-as-a-claude-code-plugin.md: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins — the manifest lives at .claude-plugin/plugin.json, its `name` is the namespace every plugin skill is invoked under, and a plugin without `version` falls back to its commit SHA. specs/0008 R11 fixes what this record owns and what it does not: identity, description, version, and nothing the distribution manifest already carries. additionalProperties is false because this is a file Siegard authors rather than one it reads — a typo here would ship a plugin the harness names differently, and specs/0008 relies on no behaviour absent from the documentation on the date above.

name.description: The plugin identity, and the namespace the harness prepends to every skill it ships: a skill named `knowledge-change` is invoked as `/<name>:knowledge-change`. Kebab-case because it appears verbatim in that invocation. specs/0008 R20 forbids a reserved prefix on a skill for this reason — the namespace is applied here, once.

description.description: What the plugin is, for a consumer deciding whether to enable it. Not a changelog and not a capability list: specs/0008 R12 puts the installed inventory in the distribution manifest, and R11 forbids the two records from duplicating a field.

version.description: The framework version, set explicitly. specs/0008 R2: a plugin without one falls back to its commit SHA, which makes every commit a release and takes the framework's version out of the framework's hands. Semantic versioning, because .claude/rules/compatibility.md decides what a breaking change is and a consumer needs the major to mean it.
